highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility, native-library reliability, and allocation behavior across common rendering workloads.
highlights_body: Apple deployment support moves to current native baselines, WebAssembly applications can link C sources again, and Android texture rendering now follows display timing. The release also fixes Linux HarfBuzz symbol conflicts and reduces allocations in image and text processing.

breaking.title: Apple native deployment baselines increased
breaking.body: Native libraries now require macOS 11.0 or iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14.0. Update applications that target older Apple operating-system versions before adopting this release.

bullets.lead: Linux HarfBuzz calls stay within the bundled library
bullets.detail: Prevents font-initialization crashes when a system HarfBuzz library was loaded globally before HarfBuzzSharp.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display frames
bullets.detail: Continuous GLTextureView and MAUI SKGLView rendering is paced by display callbacks instead of repeatedly swapping as fast as possible, while explicit render requests remain responsive.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain borrowed streams
bullets.detail: Disposing an SKFrontBufferedManagedStream now releases its reference to a caller-owned SKStream without disposing that stream.
SKImage.FromPixelCopy avoids a temporary SKData wrapper when managed pixel data is valid, reducing overhead without changing results.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz text helpers reduce temporary allocations
bullets.detail: UTF-32 shaping buffers are pooled and feature formatting avoids a native feature-string allocation while preserving existing decoding behavior.

bullets.lead: Apple platform support aligns with current native baselines
bullets.detail: Native packages now support macOS 11.0 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14.0 or later.

bullets.lead: WebAssembly applications can link C sources
bullets.detail: The WebGPU C++ port is bundled into libSkiaSharp.a, removing C++ compiler flags from application link lines so WebAssembly projects that link C sources build successfully.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Fixed Linux HarfBuzz symbol preemption and improved browser-sample paint synchronization
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Updated repository text to address contextual language findings
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled the WebGPU C++ port into the WebAssembly native library
